current_primary_readbacks.iod2025_version_rule: Use corrected v2 LSOA files; File 7 Crime fields are relative context only.

sources.name: IoD2025 corrected File 7 v2
sources.semantic_limit: Relative LSOA context only; not an absolute parcel security percentage.

sources.name: Street-level crimes API
sources.semantic_limit: Anonymised approximate locations; area support only, not exact parcel incidents.

sources.name: Police recorded crime and outcomes open data tables
sources.semantic_limit: PFA and CSP aggregate calibration only; too coarse for direct parcel attribution.

sources.name: Crime in England and Wales PFA data tables
LSOA21 BGC V5 boundaries
sources.semantic_limit: Boundary vintage must match the 2021 LSOA statistical join.

sources.name: Fire and rescue incident statistics
sources.semantic_limit: Do not merge into crime score without a separately approved model.

sources.name: LSOA mid-2024 population estimates
sources.semantic_limit: Rate denominator and QA only; not direct safety evidence.

sources.name: LSOA population density
sources.semantic_limit: Exposure-density QA only; not an incident count.

sources.name: Street outcomes API
sources.semantic_limit: Approximate location outcomes support only; no person-level fields retained.

sources.name: Crime Severity Score methodology
sources.semantic_limit: Severity calibration QA only; not directly converted to a parcel score.

sources.name: Road safety open data
sources.semantic_limit: Road-collision safety is separate from crime/public-safety score.

sources.name: Recorded crime geographical reference table
sources.semantic_limit: Code mapping only; not a parcel-level evidence source.
